result.summary: Selected admission for perforated gastric/duodenal ulcers with severe malnutrition, requiring gastric drainage, duodenal tube feeding, and documented parenteral nutrition with central venous access. Placement considerations include cirrhosis with ascites, anemia/coagulopathy, hypoxemia/pulmonary edema, and atrial fibrillation/SVT; DNR and palliative-care status are documented. Prior intubation was in 2148, with no current invasive ventilation supported. No contact-isolation indication is present.
result.contact_isolation_reason: No contact-precaution organism or explicit precaution documented; current peritoneal cultures show no growth. Chronic hepatitis C alone does not support contact isolation.
drips: Parenteral nutrition (documented 2149-10-02; ongoing infusion status unspecified)
lines: Central venous infusion catheter terminating in the superior vena cava (placed 2149-10-03)
